interpretation.summary: A dark, driving synth-pop track in the style of 80s EBM/darkwave, built on a propulsive four-on-the-floor beat, gritty analog-style bass sequences, and arpeggiated synth leads. The mood is tense and energetic, with a clear A minor tonality and heavily processed female vocals.

vocabulary.timbre: Primarily gritty, detuned analog synth emulations (sawtooth, square) with occasional brighter, metallic FM textures.
vocabulary.brightness: Bright and present in the high-mids, with a cutting lead synth and crisp percussion over a darker bass foundation; spectral centroid is moderately high.
vocabulary.envelope: Dominated by tight, percussive, and short-decay envelopes for bass, arps, and drums, creating a strong rhythmic pulse.
vocabulary.register_density: Starts sparse, building to a dense mid-to-high register arrangement with a constant low-end anchor from the bass and kick drum.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: Firmly in A minor, using progressions like i-VII-III-VI (Am-G-C-F) to create a classic darkwave harmonic feel.
vocabulary.groove: A straight and relentless 4/4 machine groove at 126 BPM, with constant 16th-note motion in the bass and arpeggiator.
vocabulary.space_grit: The mix combines dry, upfront rhythmic elements with a moderately large, reverberant space for vocals and leads, while key synth parts feature noticeable saturation and drive.

tracks.name: Kick
tracks.pattern: Standard four-on-the-floor kick pattern on every quarter note.
tracks.description: The foundation of the rhythm section, providing a constant pulse throughout most of the track.

tracks.name: Snare
tracks.pattern: Hits on beats 2 and 4, providing the backbeat.
tracks.description: A sharp, filtered noise hit that functions as the snare drum, cutting through the mix.

tracks.name: Hi-Hats
tracks.pattern: Constant 16th-note pattern with slight velocity variations (not shown in steps).
tracks.description: Provides high-frequency rhythmic energy and drives the top-end of the groove.

tracks.name: Sequenced Bass
tracks.pattern: Continuous 16th-note pattern following the root notes of the chord progression.
tracks.description: A gritty, driving bassline that acts as a core melodic and rhythmic engine. Enters from the beginning. It has a slight filter pluck on each note.

tracks.name: Arp Lead
tracks.pattern: An arpeggiated 16th-note figure that outlines the chords. Plays a counter-rhythm to the bass.
tracks.description: A brighter, detuned synth lead that adds harmonic complexity and rhythmic interest. Enters during the intro and features prominently in instrumental sections.

tracks.name: Chorus Pad
tracks.pattern: Sustained chords that change every 2 or 4 bars, following the main harmony.
tracks.description: A thick, wide pad that enters during the chorus sections to add weight and harmonic depth. It sits in the background behind the leads and vocals.

tracks.name: Accent Arp
tracks.pattern: Sparse, higher-register arpeggiated pattern that appears during vocal phrases.
tracks.description: A bell-like, metallic synth that provides punctuation and call-and-response with the vocals. First appears around 0:30. Its tone is more piercing than the main arp.
